newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee legislature okays potential gas tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee legislature okays potential gas tax hike.

text.p: Tennessee's Legislature has approved a bill that would offset any decrease in the federal gasoline tax by raising the state gasoline tax.
The Senate approved the proposal on Thursday. It was approved in the House earlier in the week and now goes to Gov. Don Sundquist, who has said he supports it.

Under the bill, if Congress cuts federal fuel taxes, the state's gasoline tax would automatically rise by the same amount. The added state revenues would be used to repair and build roads and bridges.
